title: DAY 4: THE CAMP
lessons: Sanitation: put the latrine at least ~200 ft (60 m) from water and from camp, downhill; wash hands with soap (or sanitizer) after every use.

Safe drinking water: bring clear water to a rolling boil for 1 minute; or disinfect clear water with UNSCENTED household bleach — the number of drops is on the label (about 8 drops per gallon for 6% bleach), stir, wait 30 minutes.
Disaster communities: in the first days people usually cooperate — organize shifts and give everyone a job, including kids.
Mark and protect the water source: rope it off, label it, no washing or rinsing near it.
cast_notes: First lines: MS. ORTEGA (new look: rig extra — steel coat, short fog hair, coach's whistle on a lanyard drawn as a prop), CAL PRUITT (same look as Wes — identical cap — plus an ankle splint and a branch crutch from s10 on), BENNY OCHOA (Ep 3 v2 look), DARLA FINCH (Ep 3 v2 look), LEO (Benny's son, kid extra, silent). scenes.title: The Roof
scenes.action: DAY (Episode 4 is the series' first daylight episode since Episode 2: flat gray overcast, light rain, no night grade). Main Street after the water: mud, debris, the harbor low (harbor.setLevel near lowY/drainedY). The hardware store (buildings.hardware, GULL HARBOR wall sign). CAL PRUITT sits on the edge of the flat roof/parapet, one leg out stiff (ankle), waving his cap. Wes runs in below and shouts up; Drizzle and Benny follow, still roped. Wes climbs a fallen ladder/debris pile; they pass a rope up; Cal ties on; Wes and Benny take his weight and Drizzle braces at the back of the line (comic strain). Cal is lowered down onto Wes' shoulder. Ends with Cal standing on one foot between Wes and Benny, arms over their shoulders; Drizzle flops back in the mud.
scenes.end: Cal down, propped between Wes and Benny; Drizzle sitting in the mud.

captions.speaker: CAL
captions.text: Ankle's gone. Rest of me's fine.

captions.speaker: DRIZZLE
captions.text: Good news: he's alive. Bad news: he's heavy.

scenes.title: Day Four
scenes.action: DAY (Episode 4 is the series' first daylight episode since Episode 2: flat gray overcast, light rain, no night grade). 0–2.6 s: the big DAY card — 'DAY 4' in League Gothic slicker yellow with the hand-drawn underline and a small subtitle 'THE CAMP' (same treatment as Ep 2's DAY 1 card) over the camp. Then the 'since last time' MONTAGE: 5 hard cuts of ~1.25 s, each a tight framing on ONE concrete change in the camp: (1) the BOILING STATION — Benny's two-burner stove on a flat rock outside, a big pot with steam; (2) a LATRINE SCREEN (tarp on poles) far downhill with a hand-lettered sign 'LATRINE →'; (3) a FIRST-AID corner — a crate with a hand-lettered paper cross sign 'FIRST AID' under the canopy; (4) the SIGN-UP BOARD — a sheet 'SHIFTS: WATER / WOOD / LATRINE / WATCH' with names; (5) two kids carrying a water jug between them. No dialogue.

captions.text: Three days. No helicopter. But the camp had a toilet.

scenes.title: The Count
scenes.action: DAY (Episode 4 is the series' first daylight episode since Episode 2: flat gray overcast, light rain, no night grade). The three TRACKER CARDS (bible §3.2) slide in stacked at left over the busy camp (paper cards on a dark panel, League Gothic numbers, ink labels): WATER LEFT 6 DAYS · FOOD LEFT 10 DAYS · PEOPLE IN CAMP 212. Each card lands with a small bounce, 0.4 s apart. Behind, the camp works (extras carrying wood, water).

captions.text: Two hundred twelve people. Every one of them with a job.

scenes.title: By Twos
scenes.action: DAY (Episode 4 is the series' first daylight episode since Episode 2: flat gray overcast, light rain, no night grade). Under/in front of the canopy. MS. ORTEGA (new: the teacher; steel rain shell, short fog-gray hair, a coach's whistle on a lanyard at her chest) blows the whistle at 0.1–0.6 s (two short blasts; draw small puff lines) and a line of kids and a few adults forms in pairs in front of her. Drizzle hops into line, looks around for a partner, grabs Mags' arm; Mags looks at him over her glasses.
scenes.start: Ortega with the whistle; people milling.
scenes.end: A neat double line; Drizzle arm-in-arm with Mags.

captions.speaker: MS. ORTEGA
captions.text: Buddy's name, out loud. Adults too.

scenes.title: The Board
scenes.action: DAY (Episode 4 is the series' first daylight episode since Episode 2: flat gray overcast, light rain, no night grade). Gord at his BEST: standing by the sign-up board in the canopy (canopy.board = the old missing-persons whiteboard, now with a paper SHIFTS sheet and a second sheet 'WHO HAS WHAT' pinned beside it), clipboard in hand, upbeat, pointing people to the sheets; extras queue and write their names. Drizzle signs up (big flourish). Last line: Gord taps the WHO HAS WHAT sheet with his pen and smiles a little too long (hold on him).
scenes.end: Gord tapping the WHO HAS WHAT sheet, smiling.

captions.speaker: GORD
captions.text: Folks! Shifts are on the board.

captions.speaker: GORD
captions.text: Water, wood, latrine, watch. Sign up.

scenes.title: Boiling Station
scenes.action: DAY (Episode 4 is the series' first daylight episode since Episode 2: flat gray overcast, light rain, no night grade). Shelter set: BENNY OCHOA's boiling station OUTSIDE in the open on the flat rock (front right): the two-burner camp stove (pale flame), a big pot with a rolling boil (bubbles + steam), a row of jugs. Benny stands proudly by it with a wind-up kitchen timer; his son LEO (kid extra) beside him. Drizzle arrives with two jugs. Benny turns the timer; the boil keeps rolling through the sign.
scenes.end: Pot at a rolling boil, timer ticking.

captions.speaker: BENNY
captions.text: Stove stays outside. Learned that one.

captions.speaker: BENNY
captions.text: Nothing else to do up here.
BOIL: A ROLLING BOIL FOR 1 FULL MINUTE

scenes.title: Bleach
scenes.action: DAY (Episode 4 is the series' first daylight episode since Episode 2: flat gray overcast, light rain, no night grade). Under the tarp: Mags at the crate with the rain-catch BUCKET (clear water) and a white jug of household bleach with a hand-drawn label 'BLEACH · UNSCENTED' (no brand). She holds up the jug and taps the label, counts drops (tiny drops from the cap), stirs with a stick, then holds up a hand: wait. Drizzle crouches by the bucket, staring at it.
scenes.end: Drizzle staring at the bucket, waiting.

captions.speaker: MAGS
captions.text: Unscented. The label tells you how many drops.
BLEACH: UNSCENTED ONLY · DROPS PER LABEL · WAIT 30 MIN

scenes.title: First Aid
scenes.action: DAY (Episode 4 is the series' first daylight episode since Episode 2: flat gray overcast, light rain, no night grade). The FIRST-AID corner in the left bay of the canopy: a crate table with a paper cross sign 'FIRST AID'. DANA REYES (forearm in white gauze) kneels by CAL, who sits on a cooler with his ankle splinted (two boards + strips of cloth), leg up on a crate. Drizzle walks in carrying HIS first-aid kit (his go-bag is back — Gord handed it over this morning, empty of nothing but the water; the 'found' is said with air quotes: Drizzle does finger quotes) (the red-cross pouch from his go-bag, drawn in muted gray/paper with an ink cross — no red) and sets it on the crate. Dana raises an eyebrow; Drizzle pats it.
scenes.start: Dana and Cal at the crate.
scenes.end: The kit open on the crate; Drizzle proud.

captions.speaker: DRIZZLE
captions.text: It's not a snack bag anymore. It's the camp's.

scenes.title: Not Here
scenes.action: DAY (Episode 4 is the series' first daylight episode since Episode 2: flat gray overcast, light rain, no night grade). By the tents (tents[0..1] area). TESS (padlocked duffel on her shoulder) has been watching Drizzle from her tent; MILO (with a small flashlight on a lanyard round his neck) tugs her coat. Tess walks over to Drizzle, glances at the crowd near the canopy, keeps her voice low; she nods toward the back of the shelter/cabin (off left). Drizzle looks back at Mags, then follows.

scenes.title: The Duffel
scenes.action: DAY (Episode 4 is the series' first daylight episode since Episode 2: flat gray overcast, light rain, no night grade). Behind the cabin by the utility shed (shelter set, right side), out of sight of the camp. Tess kneels, unlocks the padlock with a small key on a cord, unzips the duffel: inside, neatly packed, a small insulated pouch; she opens it — small vials and pens (draw as paper/fog rounded shapes with ink caps). Close insert panel on the vials. Drizzle crouches, serious for once. On his promise he draws an X over his heart. Milo watches from the corner.
scenes.end: Duffel zipped again; Drizzle's hand on his heart.

captions.speaker: TESS
captions.text: It lasts a few weeks out of one.

captions.speaker: TESS
captions.text: If they know, they'll want it.

scenes.title: Two Hundred Feet
scenes.action: DAY (Episode 4 is the series' first daylight episode since Episode 2: flat gray overcast, light rain, no night grade). Below the camp on the slope (the hillside trail, the water tank / creek NOT on this side — keep the bay far left). Mags (radio on her hip) and Drizzle walk DOWNHILL (right→left along trailY), Drizzle counting giant steps out loud with a shovel over his shoulder; Mags points back uphill (toward the camp and its water) and then down at a spot well below. Drizzle drives the shovel in. A small hand-lettered stake 'LATRINE' goes in.
scenes.start: Mags and Drizzle leaving the camp edge.
scenes.end: The shovel in the ground, the LATRINE stake.

captions.speaker: MAGS
captions.text: Downhill. Well away from the water.
LATRINE: 200 FT / 60 M FROM WATER AND CAMP, DOWNHILL

scenes.title: Soap
scenes.action: DAY (Episode 4 is the series' first daylight episode since Episode 2: flat gray overcast, light rain, no night grade). Same place, an hour later: a tarp LATRINE SCREEN on three poles; beside it a HAND-WASH station — a jug hung on a post with a stick tap, a bar of soap on a string, a basin below. Drizzle steps out from behind the screen, proud, and gives a thumbs up; Mags points at the soap without a word; Drizzle washes his hands (water stream from the jug), then shakes them dry.

captions.speaker: DRIZZLE
captions.text: Good news: I'm still waterproof. Bad news: so is the latrine.
WASH HANDS WITH SOAP AFTER EVERY USE

scenes.title: Protect It
scenes.action: DAY (Episode 4 is the series' first daylight episode since Episode 2: flat gray overcast, light rain, no night grade). The water tank (far left, the taped crack) and a rain-catch tarp funneling into barrels beside it. WES strings a rope barrier on stakes around it; CAL (one foot, a crutch made of a branch) hangs a hand-lettered sign 'DRINKING WATER ONLY · NO WASHING'. A kid starts to rinse a muddy boot in a barrel — Wes gently steers him away. At ~15 s Mags' radio (she is passing by) crackles: she stops, lifts it (static squiggles).
scenes.end: Rope + sign up; Mags lifting the crackling radio.

captions.speaker: WES
captions.text: Rope it off. Nobody washes here.
MARK AND PROTECT THE WATER SOURCE

scenes.title: Population Centers
scenes.action: DAY (Episode 4 is the series' first daylight episode since Episode 2: flat gray overcast, light rain, no night grade). (late afternoon, a little darker). Under the canopy the crowd presses around Mags, who sits cranking the radio (crank circling, static squiggles). Faces lean in. DARLA (dead phone in her hand, checking it) turns to the crowd, scared. Gord climbs onto the picnic table with his clipboard and raises both hands, steady and calm (he is good at this).
scenes.end: Gord on the table, hands up; the crowd settling.

captions.speaker: GORD
captions.text: We have a plan. We have a list.

scenes.title: Everybody Gets a Job
scenes.action: EVENING (dusk grade like Ep 3 s02): the fire ring (firePit) with small pale flames; Drizzle, Mags and Milo sit around it, Milo playing his lanyard flashlight over the ground. In-character recap of the lessons. On 'Head of flashlights' Milo clicks the light on under his chin and grins.
scenes.end: Milo grinning, light under his chin.

captions.text: In most disasters, people help each other first.

captions.speaker: MAGS
captions.text: Soap. And everybody gets a job.

scenes.title: The List
scenes.action: NIGHT (night grade like Ep 3, figures lit by one flashlight). The empty canopy; the sign-up board with the SHIFTS sheet and the WHO HAS WHAT sheet. Gord comes in with a flashlight, looks over his shoulder at the dark camp, and peels the WHO HAS WHAT sheet off the board (pin pops; same framing as the cold open), folds it, tucks it into his clipboard, and walks to his tent (tents[1] with the G. PIKE sign and clipboard from Ep 3 v2), ducks inside; the tent glows, then goes dark. Across the camp, Drizzle (by the fire ring, small) looks up. At 20.4 s the NEXT sting: 'NEXT: DAY 9' (same card treatment as Ep 3 v2 s17: big title once, no caption copy) over the dark camp.

captions.text: That night, the list of who had what...
